subject: leaf-caped mouse
art_direction: 小鼠披一片叶形绿毡，圆耳和灰白身露出，双手搭在披肩边。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make a small mouse with round gray-cream felt ears and a single leaf-shaped green cape. Its paws hold the cape edges just below a shy curious face. Keep the leaf vein as one embroidered line rather than detailed botanical texture. Use dense felt, soft cut edges, and a tiny warm-brown nose on pale blue-gray cloth. The cape and body should form one compact silhouette without a hat or scenery. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
